now I understand the truth
+
+
+it bursts in my desires
+
+
+and in my misfortunes
+
+in my failed encounters
+
+in my imbalances
+
+in my deliriums
+
+
+now I understand the truth
+
+
+now
+
+to go in search of life

translation.title: Only
translation.editorial_note: Truth is not stated but located in desire, disaster, disjunction, and delirium; the final infinitive leaves the search for life just beginning.
